topic: DMs cannot be opened whole, and chat_kind is unindexed in older collections
detail: (1) GetDocument, ListSources and orch rag show leave DMs out for every caller, so a DM the operator finds with orch search --direct-messages cannot be opened whole; a DM-aware document read would need the same operator gate. (2) The chat_kind keyword index is created only with a new collection; existing ones filter on it unindexed (correct, slower). Add it lazily when chat content first lands.
